module.title: Search and Operational Index Projections
module.business_purpose: Provides full-text, faceted, geospatial and operational search projections. Search documents are derived copies, never the authoritative source. Clinical search uses preauthorized, redacted projections with tenant, patient, purpose-of-use and principal filters.
